stories.title: Man, 37, charged with domestic violence offences in Buckley
stories.summary: A man from Buckley has been charged with assault occasioning actual bodily harm and intentional strangulation. North Wales Police said Lee Owen, 37, of Brunswick Road, Buckley, was charged in connection with domestic violence offences. The force said the incidents took place in Buckley on Friday 7 August. stories.title: First Minister to convene Wales wildfire summit after emergency meeting

stories.title: Deeside liquid carbon capture plant given green light
stories.summary: The carbon capture phase of a new £282 million waste-to-energy plant on Deeside Industrial Estate has been approved.
